Binary package hint: gxemul

Giving gxemul invalid command line parameters can result in a segmentation fault. Simplest way to reproduce:

ski@ganiodayo:/tmp$ gxemul a
GXemul 0.4.6.3    Copyright (C) 2003-2008  Anders Gavare
Read the source code and/or documentation for other Copyright messages.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Segmentation fault

entries.content:

---------------
gxemul (0.4.6.6-3) unstable; urgency=low

  * Patch against segmentation fault if gxemul is started with arbitrary 
    parameters (LP: #301041)
